canonical_specification.title: Fiscal policy and public debt
canonical_specification.outcome: Derive debt dynamics and evaluate fiscal trade-offs with explicit assumptions.

assignments.fixed_scope: Derive government nominal and real period budget constraints with unambiguous interest/debt/primary-balance timing. Derive exact debt-to-GDP law and stationary/unstable boundary cases before approximations; separate valuation, primary balance, inflation and growth effects. Develop present-value solvency under an explicit terminal/no-Ponzi condition without equating a debt ratio with a universal safe threshold. Teach fiscal multipliers with automatic stabilizers/instrument assumptions and financing/expectation qualification, fiscal space and distribution; use original fully reconciled scenarios,8solved exercises and a reproducible debt-path lab. No current sovereign-risk or legal assertion without dated official inspection.

canonical_specification.title: Trade and comparative advantage
canonical_specification.outcome: Derive gains and distributional effects from trade models.

assignments.fixed_scope: Teach Ricardian opportunity costs and gains with feasible production/consumption and balanced international transactions; distinguish individual distributive loss from aggregate feasible gains. Derive a bounded factor-endowment/relative-factor-reward example with explicit diversification assumptions and limits. Teach scale and heterogeneous-firm selection using a stated demand/cost/entry or export-cutoff mechanism, deriving the claimed global choices. Reconcile small-country tariff consumer/producer/revenue/welfare effects and distinguish a large-country terms-of-trade channel under explicit foreign response. At least2fulloriginalworkedexamples and8fully solved exercises; scope any general theorem requiring graduate tools; primary methods actually inspected, no invented current tariff rules or statistics.

canonical_specification.title: Exchange rates and external balances
canonical_specification.outcome: Connect international accounts, exchange-rate mechanisms and policy regimes.

assignments.fixed_scope: Reconcile current/capital/financial accounts, transaction signs, errors/omissions and changes in net foreign assets including valuation/other changes under an explicitly dated official accounting convention. Verify which IMFmanual edition/method is actually cited and do not call older conventions current without checking. Fix exchange-rate quote homecurrencyperforeigncurrency, derive real rate/PPP conditions, exact one-period covered interest parity and its financing/access assumptions, distinguish uncovered expected returns from no-arbitrage/risk compensation. Teach capital-flow mechanisms and fixed/floating monetary regimes with complete balance-sheet/market closure and feasible original cases. At least2fullworkedexamples and8fully solved exercises plus reproducible reconciliation if useful. Source actual primary passages; no fabricated current exchange-rate or country data.

assignments.task: Crises, policy regimes and macroeconomic judgment

canonical_specification.title: Crises, policy regimes and macroeconomic judgment
canonical_specification.outcome: Compare crisis mechanisms and evaluate a country case without claiming certainty from one model.

assignments.fixed_scope: Teach distinct bank liquidity, bank solvency, collateral/leverage feedback, foreign-currency/sudden-stop and sovereign distress mechanisms with explicit timing/balance sheets/constraints. Construct a bounded original crisis scenario and policy tradeoff with complete resource/loss accounting; demonstrate uncertainty and regime-dependence rather than guaranteeing a rescue or forecasting a crisis. Compare at least two historical crisis episodes using actual dated primary official/author evidence, separating evidence from model analogy and avoiding unsupported causal certainty. Provide reproducible scenario inputs/benchmark with stated parameter assumptions and a country-case decision protocol,8fully solved exercises with open-question criteria, teaching/retention. Coordinate c09 debt and c11 external-account conventions; historical amounts remain dated, no inventedOctober2026 observations.
